scope: Herbal production, physical medical logistics, policies, wound infection and shared immunity, actual bed rest and preserved v18 saves. Controlled rules, ordinary gameplay, browser interactions and native observations are separately identified.

medicalTests.title: uses soil and each physical chunk in the treatment room, retaining the snapshot after hauling
applies downed rest immunity only in a real bed (bed=false)
applies downed rest immunity only in a real bed (bed=true)
walking or standing on a bed cell does not grant bed or resting immunity factors
fetches a real upper-floor herb, retains age and progress across reload, and uses one for multiple wounds
changing medical policy during transport cancels treatment without consuming or deleting cargo
a second doctor cannot reserve the same patient, and policy noMedicine leaves the real herb untouched
herbs rotting while carried release care and account for spoilage without a free treatment
an infected mobile patient walks upstairs to an actual medical bed and stays despite full rest
sowing healroot requires skill 8, longer real work and preserves work identity when changing crops
harvesting mature healroot produces finite perishable medicine rather than food
migrates original published v18 working bytes without rerolling old injuries or granting medicine
migrates original published v18 injured bytes without rerolling old injuries or granting medicine
rejects duplicated infection identity, impossible reservations and changed saved factors
crush wounds can carry an infection risk, but bruises and solid parts cannot
a medicine batch skips oversized middle injuries and includes a later fitting one
no medicine treats only one injury while a single injury exceeding 20 still qualifies
life-threatening infection takes precedence over small bleeds without consuming every infection in a batch
mild infection precedes a nonbleeding bruise despite the bruise having higher severity
infection treatment permits strict overlap and adds the remaining treatment time
secondary infection risk uses current severity, tending quality and the saved room factor
pending infection survives JSON roundtrip and resolves exactly once
existing immunity blocks a new infection near sixty percent; it is not multiplied into a probabilistic trial
immunity is shared and grows once with the first surviving infection factor
healing the source wound does not cure an existing infection
immunity recovery and residual immunity decay use separate rates
starts residual immunity decay on the update that removes the last healed infection
repeated real treatment batches allow a controlled infection to reach immunity and clear, while no care can be lethal
starvation, exhaustion, blood filtration and resting affect actual immunity gain
lethal severity is evaluated before reaching immunity in the same update
extreme infection changes pain, consciousness and breathing in the existing body model
infection can exhaust breathing already reduced by airway damage
herbs are bounded perishable medicine and are not grain with a food crop tag

campaign.scope: Fresh seed 73129. Only construction, work, farming, storage, medical, movement and combat commands, step, save and load change the simulation. Terrain, paths and state are read to plan. No injected items, resources, injuries, skills, knowledge, infection timers, clock, random state, temperatures or enemies. Delayed untreated, no-medicine and herbal-care branches explicitly reload recorded ordinary-play saves. Natural noninfection and deaths are retained, not rerolled. This is a gameplay case study, not an infection-probability experiment.

mainPageIsolateHeapObservation.interpretation: Natural GC/JIT noise is retained. This is one page isolate and is not a whole-page or whole-browser leak/capacity claim.

developmentFailures.detail: Native UI showed ordinary bed immunity at 107%. Static XML parent closure located SansComfortBedBase. Final source includes 1.07, resting 1.1, Crush infecter and severity/removal-before-immunity ordering.

A first run reported all 644 assertions passed but exited 1 with a Vitest onTaskUpdate timeout. It was not accepted. Final full suite is separately recorded with process exit and unhandled-error audit.

A delayed-care infected patient bled to death before medicine could arrive. The original campaign incorrectly assumed a completed treatment. The final fresh campaign retains adverse branches and observes early treatment from the same actual wound save, without changing pending infection rolls.

limitations: Only healroot, herbal medicine, three care policies and wound infection. No industrial/glitterworld drugs, hospital beds, self-tending, surgery, prostheses, animal care, other disease types, genes or age effects.

20 TPS and 12000 ticks/day, keyed randomness and per-tick disease integration are project adaptations. Source daily rates and ordering are retained; native float bits, global RNG and hashed update times are not replayed.

Native room region eligibility differs from enclosed 3D room eligibility. Project cleanliness includes mapped soil and physical chunks; no dynamic filth, cleaning jobs, sterile flooring or complete furniture cleanliness.

Unit scenes explicitly prepare injuries, anatomy, medicine and geometry. The separate final campaign starts fresh and uses normal commands/step/save/load, with recorded counterfactual care branches. One sequence cannot estimate infection or recovery probability.

Native infection is explicitly Dev-prepared, followed by normal tending and elapsed time. It does not demonstrate natural infection frequency or an otherwise controlled comparison of medicine efficacy.

Browser tests use visible controls and read-only snapshot/projection observations, not screen-only perception. Six lifecycle cycles cover renderer resource convergence and main-page heap only; no universal 4 GB capacity claim or long-duration leak proof.
Normal-care and delayed-care comparison branches explicitly reload the same real wound. They are counterfactual gameplay branches, not independent trials.
